name: latex-workshop
description: Read, edit, and compile Mind Palace LaTeX projects on Workshop mentions or LaTeX file requests.

interface.shortDescription: Organize, edit, and compile private LaTeX projects.
interface.longDescription: Organize folders and tags, place projects intelligently, and edit site-hosted LaTeX Workshop projects from ChatGPT or Codex through project-scoped access, immediate atomic edits with undo, live compilation, and optional review proposals. Select automatically on Workshop mentions or LaTeX file editing/querying requests, including follow-ups. Generic proof checking alone does not activate it.
defaultPrompt: Fix and compile my Mind Palace paper.
Create a LaTeX Workshop project from a template.
Organize my LaTeX Workshop projects into folders and tags.
